mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BOARD_IMG (IMG_ID, IMG_NO, ORIGIN_NAME, CHANGE_NAME, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_BINO.NEXTVAL, #{imgNo}, #{originName}, #{changeName}, DEFAULT)
mapper.select: SELECT IMG_ID imgId , IMG_NO imgNo , ORIGIN_NAME originName , CHANGE_NAME changeName , STATUS status FROM TB_BOARD_IMG WHERE IMG_NO = #{imgNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BOARD_IMG SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE IMG_NO = #{imgNo}
